kind: engineering robustness check of named-atom extraction and kinase descriptors on public crystal structures; no state labels, no classification, no biological claim
frozen_before: any coordinate file of the panel was downloaded or inspected (only RCSB entry metadata and UniProt accessions were read)
panel_rationale: five kinases from different groups (AGC, CMGC, Other/Aurora, TKL), with or without ligands, one or two kinase chains; chosen for diversity of constructs and coordinate quality, not for any expected conformational state
primary_chain_rule: every kinase chain listed is processed; the first listed chain of each entry is the primary row, others are additional rows

role_positions_uniprot.source: standard residue numbering of these kinases as used in the literature (catalytic Lys, alphaC Glu, DFG, HRD/YRD motifs); each position is checked against the UniProt sequence in the run, and a mismatch is a mapping failure

checks.C1_uniprot_role_identity: at the UniProt positions: beta3_Lys = K, alphaC_Glu = E, DFG_Asp-Phe-Gly = D-F-G, the residue after XHRD is H or Y followed by R-D; any mismatch = mapping failure
checks.C2_numbering_mapping: PDB author numbering -> UniProt by the single offset that maximises exact residue identity over the chain; accepted if identity >= 0.95 of observed residues; mismatches listed (mutations, tags); insertion codes counted and, if any fall in role residues, the role is a mapping failure
checks.C3_role_residue_identity_in_structure: the structure's residue names at the mapped role positions agree with UniProt; a disagreement is listed (engineered mutation) and the dependent descriptors are flagged
checks.C4_required_atom_coverage: extract_atoms(role_request, on_missing='mark'): per-atom status present / atom_not_found / residue_not_found; coverage fraction; descriptors with a missing atom are NaN with the named atom (kinase_descriptors)
checks.C5_missing_atom_consistency: atoms reported missing by the adapter for role residues must equal those listed in the file's REMARK 470 (missing atoms) and REMARK 465 (missing residues) records for those residues
checks.C6_alternate_locations: role residues with altlocs listed; descriptors computed under blank_then_A and highest_occupancy; within every role residue at most one non-blank altloc identifier is used (no mixed conformers); maximum descriptor change reported
checks.C7_independent_parser: all descriptors recomputed with an independent fixed-column PDB parser (first model; blank-or-A altloc) and compared with the blank_then_A run; pass if max |difference| <= 1e-3 (A or rad)
checks.C8_calpha_identity: Calpha of the role residues from extract_atoms equals extract_ca bit for bit under both altloc policies
checks.C9_determinism: a second extraction gives bit-identical coordinates
checks.C10_geometry_plausibility: for role residues: N-CA, CA-C, C=O, CA-CB bond lengths within 0.10 A of 1.458, 1.525, 1.231, 1.530 A (Engh & Huber ideal values) and Phe CG-CZ within 0.10 A of 2.78 A; outliers are reported as coordinate warnings, not failures

outcome_per_chain.fail: any of C1, C2 (identity < 0.95), C5, C7, C8 or C9 fails, or C6 finds mixed conformers
outcome_per_chain.pass_with_exclusions: no failure, but at least one descriptor is NaN because of a recorded missing atom or residue, or C3 lists a role-residue mutation
outcome_per_chain.pass: no failure and all descriptors computed

permitted_interpretation: Engineering and representation evidence for atom extraction on these 9 chains: whether mapping, coverage, missing-atom reporting, altloc handling and descriptor computation behave as specified. Descriptor values are reported but not classified; no DFG/alphaC state is assigned or compared with any label; no biological, general-kinase or performance claim.
